title: "Type I Error"
execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
devtools::load_all()

n_sim <- 10000

method_colors <- c(
  "z.test.gaussian"      = "#E41A1C",
  "z.test.oracle.kappa"  = "#377EB8",
  "bs.multiplier"        = "#4DAF4A",
  "bs.parametric"        = "#FF7F00",
  "bs.parametric.psd"    = "#0072B2",
  "z.test.null"          = "#984EA3",
  "z.test.null.gaussian" = "#A65628"
)
```

## $p = 2$: Z-Test Methods

```{r}
#| cache: true
params_p2_s1 <- scenario(1, n = 1000, err_type = "normal") 
params_p2    <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential")

pvals_z_s1 <- list(
  "Z-Test | Null, Oracle"   = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "z.test.null.oracle",   n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Null, Gaussian" = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "z.test.null.gaussian", n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Null"           = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "z.test.null",          n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Oracle"         = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "z.test.oracle",        n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Gaussian"       = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "z.test.gaussian",      n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test"                  = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "z.test",               n_sim = n_sim)
)

pvals_z_s2 <- list(
  "Z-Test | Null, Oracle"   = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.null.oracle",   n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Null, Gaussian" = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.null.gaussian", n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Null"           = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.null",          n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Oracle"         = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.oracle",        n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test | Gaussian"       = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.gaussian",      n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test"                  = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test",               n_sim = n_sim)
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Scenario 1 (Gaussian)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_z_s1, title = "p = 2 — Scenario 1, Gaussian errors, σ = (1, 1)", dir = "v", ncol = 2)
```

## Scenario 2, L=4 (Exponential)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_z_s2, title = "p = 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors, σ = (1, 1)", dir = "v", ncol = 2)
```

:::

## $p = 2$: Bootstrap Methods

```{r}
#| cache: true
pvals_bs_s1 <- list(
  "Bootstrap | Multiplier"           = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "bs.multiplier",         n_sim = n_sim),
  "Bootstrap | Multiplier, No Split" = pcurve(params_p2_s1, "bs.multiplier.nosplit",  n_sim = n_sim)
)

pvals_bs_s2 <- list(
  "Bootstrap | Multiplier"           = pcurve(params_p2, "bs.multiplier",         n_sim = n_sim),
  "Bootstrap | Multiplier, No Split" = pcurve(params_p2, "bs.multiplier.nosplit",  n_sim = n_sim)
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Scenario 1 (Normal)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_bs_s1, title = "p = 2 — Scenario 1, normal errors, σ = (1, 1)", ncol = 2)
```

## Scenario 2, L=4 (Exponential)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_bs_s2, title = "p = 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors, σ = (1, 1)", ncol = 2)
```

:::

## $p > 2$: Multiplier Bootstrap

```{r}
params_p3_s1  <- scenario(1, n = 1000, err_type = "normal",            p = 3)
params_p5_s1  <- scenario(1, n = 1000, err_type = "normal",            p = 5)
params_p10_s1 <- scenario(1, n = 1000, err_type = "normal",            p = 10)
params_p3_s2  <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential", p = 3)
params_p5_s2  <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential", p = 5)
params_p10_s2 <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential", p = 10)
```

```{r mult-p3}
#| cache: true
pvals_mult_p3_s1 <- pcurve(params_p3_s1, "bs.multiplier", n_sim = n_sim)
pvals_mult_p3_s2 <- pcurve(params_p3_s2, "bs.multiplier", n_sim = n_sim)
```

```{r mult-p5}
#| cache: true
pvals_mult_p5_s1 <- pcurve(params_p5_s1, "bs.multiplier", n_sim = n_sim)
pvals_mult_p5_s2 <- pcurve(params_p5_s2, "bs.multiplier", n_sim = n_sim)
```

```{r mult-p10}
#| cache: true
pvals_mult_p10_s1 <- pcurve(params_p10_s1, "bs.multiplier", n_sim = n_sim)
pvals_mult_p10_s2 <- pcurve(params_p10_s2, "bs.multiplier", n_sim = n_sim)
```

```{r}
pvals_mult_pg2_s1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pvals_mult_p3_s1,  p = factor(3,  levels = c(3, 5, 10))),
  tibble(p_value = pvals_mult_p5_s1,  p = factor(5,  levels = c(3, 5, 10))),
  tibble(p_value = pvals_mult_p10_s1, p = factor(10, levels = c(3, 5, 10)))
)

pvals_mult_pg2_s2 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pvals_mult_p3_s2,  p = factor(3,  levels = c(3, 5, 10))),
  tibble(p_value = pvals_mult_p5_s2,  p = factor(5,  levels = c(3, 5, 10))),
  tibble(p_value = pvals_mult_p10_s2, p = factor(10, levels = c(3, 5, 10)))
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Scenario 1 (Normal)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_mult_pg2_s1, facet = ~p, ncol = 3,
  title = "p > 2 — Scenario 1, normal errors, σ = (1, 1)")
```

## Scenario 2, L=4 (Exponential)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_mult_pg2_s2, facet = ~p, ncol = 3,
  title = "p > 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors, σ = (1, 1)")
```

:::

## $p > 2$: Parametric Bootstrap

```{r param-p3}
#| cache: true
pvals_param_p3_s1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p3_s1, "bs.parametric",     n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric"),
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p3_s1, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")
)
pvals_param_p3_s2 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p3_s2, "bs.parametric",     n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric"),
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p3_s2, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")
)
```

```{r param-p5}
#| cache: true
pvals_param_p5_s1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p5_s1, "bs.parametric",     n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric"),
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p5_s1, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")
)
pvals_param_p5_s2 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p5_s2, "bs.parametric",     n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric"),
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p5_s2, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")
)
```

```{r param-p10}
#| cache: true
pvals_param_p10_s1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p10_s1, "bs.parametric",     n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric"),
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p10_s1, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")
)
pvals_param_p10_s2 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p10_s2, "bs.parametric",     n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric"),
  tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p10_s2, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim), method = "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")
)
```

```{r}
p_levels <- c(3, 5, 10)
m_levels <- c("Bootstrap | Parametric", "Bootstrap | Parametric, PSD")

pvals_param_pg2_s1 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(pvals_param_p3_s1,  p = 3),
  mutate(pvals_param_p5_s1,  p = 5),
  mutate(pvals_param_p10_s1, p = 10)
) |> mutate(p = factor(p, levels = p_levels), method = factor(method, levels = m_levels))

pvals_param_pg2_s2 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(pvals_param_p3_s2,  p = 3),
  mutate(pvals_param_p5_s2,  p = 5),
  mutate(pvals_param_p10_s2, p = 10)
) |> mutate(p = factor(p, levels = p_levels), method = factor(method, levels = m_levels))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Scenario 1 (Normal)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_param_pg2_s1, facet = facet_grid(p ~ method),
  title = "p > 2 — Scenario 1, normal errors, σ = (1, 1)")
```

## Scenario 2, L=4 (Exponential)

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_param_pg2_s2, facet = facet_grid(p ~ method),
  title = "p > 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors, σ = (1, 1)")
```

:::
